title: Risk preferences upload (BOW front end, RISK_PREFFRENCES)
purpose: Which profits and losses BOW counts against margin, MTM or both, per client, exchange, market and product: the firm's nine values (Connections → BOW upload files) for every active client new or changed since the last file. The ninth-from-last field is named 'Consider Realised Loss' twice in BOW's sheet; by its place and description it is the unrealised loss. BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.

columns.name: Client Code
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC

columns.name: Exchange
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. BSE, NSE, MCX, NCDEX or ALL. Connections → BOW upload files (default ALL)

columns.name: Market
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. EQUITY, COMMODITIES … or ALL (default ALL)

columns.name: Product
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. INTRADAY, DELIVERY or ALL (default ALL)

columns.name: Consider Realised Profit
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. 1 margin, 2 MTM, 3 both. The firm's value in Connections → BOW upload files (Risk preferences)
